pages.text: A $(item)Guild Ledger$() marks a workshop for every craft: the forge, the tannery, the weaving room and the woodshop. Each craft's stations must be within 7 blocks of it across and 4 up or down. Read the ledger to see what each craft has and needs.
pages.title: One Ledger

pages.text: Each craft's workshop has three levels. The basic stations make level 1 (up to ★3); its first upgrade makes level 2 (★5); both upgrades make level 3 (★7). Decoration that suits the craft widens its sweet spots a little.$(br2)Outside the forge, a piece's ★ comes from how well you did: all gold makes the best, all green a middling piece. It's never better than the workshop, your skill or the material allows.
pages.title: Levels and ★
